  PROBLEM: scripts/clarify_isolated_run.sh:189 emits the single fixed line `clarify source snapshot rejected` for every rejection class (unsafe source path, unsafe source file, limit exceeded, OSError, UnicodeError, source-changed-during-copy). The new stop rule therefore also ends the run after one attempt for the transient `changed` race, where a re-snapshot on attempt 2 could succeed.
  WHY: Only in the source-changed race does the old three-attempt loop gain anything, and the new rule turns that into a one-attempt hard failure. The changelog's "a retry gets the same result" lacks this qualification. The reviewer calls it a wording/behavior trade-off, not a blocker, because no helper change is possible under the heal scope.
